name: Taiwan Cogeneration Corporation
summary: Taiwan Cogeneration Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the operation and management of cogeneration plants in Taiwan. It operates through Guantian Cogeneration Plant, and Construction and Consulting Services segments. The company is also involved in the engineering, planning, design, procurement, installation, construction, and financing planning of cogeneration plants; and environmental protection and procurement of fuel for cogeneration systems and related businesses.
